detail.name: Yixuan's Namecard
detail.desc: Get by unlocking Yixuan's Mindscape: Cycle of Yin and Yang
detail.desc2:
A card imprinted with the image of Yunkui Summit's Yixuan, also identifying her as a Special Investigator with the Hollow Investigative Association.
Yixuan Shifu is apparently quite elusive, and only a fated few ever receive her guidance. Who knows — this card might be your invitation into the sect.
